messages.content: Write a complete Security Council decision record, at most 160 words, using only the supplied evidence. First state the disposition and scope exactly. Attribute any delivered statement to its speaker and describe any delivered adopted clause separately. If those sources support a specific relationship, explicitly explain it without treating a preference as an adopted requirement, or a report as a decision. Keep actors, decision authority, timing and any exception distinct. Leave out details that were not delivered. Return only the final record.
